title: バンブーメモリー登場！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm Bamboo Memory, head of the Tracen Academy Disciplinary Committee!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Starting today, I'm working toward my debut! Just thinking about the exciting days ahead has me trembling with anticipation!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I can't wait because I have a blazing hot dream I wanna fulfill! One day, I want to run in the ultimate race against my ultimate rivals!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's been my dream since I was a kid, and I'll pour every ounce of energy I have into making it come true!
